description:
[US Stock Info] Get a NASDAQ fear & greed score (0 = extreme fear, 100 = extreme greed) with its six components.
    Use this for questions about market sentiment, e.g. "is the market fearful or greedy now", "NASDAQ fear and greed index".
    This is not CNN's Fear & Greed Index. It is the utils.im model, computed from NASDAQ 100 (QQQ) daily closes:
    momentum, short-term trend, 52-week range position, volatility, RSI and share of up days. Takes no arguments.

    Returns a JSON object:
        score, band: the latest score and its band (extremeFear, fear, neutral, greed, extremeGreed).
        components: each component's 0-100 score and raw value.
        compare: the score 1, 5, 21 and 250 trading days earlier.
        methodology_url: the utils.im page that documents this calculation and shows the 1-year history chart.
name: get_nasdaq_fear_greed

outputSchema.description: Generic wrapper for non-object return types.
